[b]Llàpatas and patas [/b]
Llàpatas and Patas are all "kids" of Apadri Ururi and Acachi Ururi, and refers to all stars and planets, the Llàpatas(planets) are constantly moving, without a single unique point contrary to it sisters the Patas(stars).
[i] Wachay made all the first deities from nothing, alongside Camác, Samantemán and Kón, there was also Apadri Ururi and Acachi, they were the ones to illuminate the skies before Chilla and Chatay, Apadri would reign during day, and his wife Acachi at night, but of course they could not do such difficult task, and  so Acachi created the Llàpatas, they were swift and agile moving throught the skies, for many time, they were enough.
... however when Chatay was made alongside Chilla, their bright weakened, so Apadri made the Patas, way more of them existing, and were fixed, and did not moved differently from their brothers, but still could not overcome the light of nor Chatay, but at least coexist and even show at Chilla's reign during the night .
[b]The Eyes of Chilla[/b].
Not all Llàpatas are afraid of Chilla, indeed, Káncharì(Eye One, refers to Xanadu, is slightly more bright and round, and Kámáwi, the second eye, slightly smaller than Káncharì,also having a yellowish colour, both agreed to become the "eyes of Chilla", observing the World and Humanity, with them Chilla can see everyone and everything happening on Camác after Kón fall.

[/i]
